title: Unicorn dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='mane' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5ec4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a5cff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='horn' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- mane behind head and neck -->
  <path d='M40,26 C32,20 28,26 30,32 C24,32 22,40 28,44 C24,48 26,54 32,54 L44,50 Z' fill='url(#mane)'/>
  <path d='M44,44 C38,50 40,58 48,58 C46,64 50,68 56,66 L60,54 Z' fill='url(#mane)'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M18,60 C10,58 6,66 10,72 C6,74 8,82 16,82 C14,88 20,92 26,88 C28,80 24,74 24,68 Z' fill='url(#mane)'/>

  <!-- back legs -->
  <rect x='27' y='70' width='7' height='18' rx='3.5' fill='#d9a7ff'/>
  <rect x='21' y='70' width='7' height='14' rx='3.5' fill='#b47cf0'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='60' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#f3e2ff'/>

  <!-- front dancing leg raised -->
  <path d='M50,66 C54,66 58,62 60,56 L66,58 C64,66 58,72 50,72 Z' fill='#d9a7ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='56' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffd1f0'/>

  <!-- standing front leg -->
  <rect x='46' y='68' width='7' height='20' rx='3.5' fill='#f3e2ff'/>
  <rect x='46' y='84' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b47cf0'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M46,44 L58,30 L66,38 L56,54 Z' fill='#f3e2ff'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='34' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f3e2ff' transform='rotate(-12 62 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='32' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#f3e2ff' transform='rotate(-12 72 32)'/>

  <!-- horn -->
  <polygon points='76,26 84,8 82,28' fill='url(#horn)'/>
  <path d='M78,22 L82,14' stroke='#fff6c9' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- ear -->
  <path d='M62,24 L60,15 L68,22 Z' fill='#d9a7ff'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='71' cy='30' r='2.2' fill='#5a2a8a'/>
  <circle cx='71.8' cy='29.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- nostril & smile -->
  <circle cx='77' cy='31' r='0.9' fill='#b47cf0'/>
  <path d='M73,35 Q76,38 79,35' stroke='#b47cf0' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M14,40 L16,44 L20,46 L16,48 L14,52 L12,48 L8,46 L12,44 Z' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <path d='M88,52 L89.5,55 L92.5,56.5 L89.5,58 L88,61 L86.5,58 L83.5,56.5 L86.5,55 Z' fill='#a7f3ff'/>
  <path d='M30,16 L31.3,18.7 L34,20 L31.3,21.3 L30,24 L28.7,21.3 L26,20 L28.7,18.7 Z' fill='#ffb3e6'/>
</svg>
